_about: Example rack plan for the Patchwork importer. Copy to src/data/migration-plan.local.json (gitignored) and describe your own sites. Every section is optional. Device ids and property ids are the ids used in Patchwork; model ids come from the equipment library. U1 is the bottom of a rack. Only devices that exist and aren't already placed are touched.
